content.short: Superboard is a quest platform where users try Web3 apps and earn rewards.
content.description: Superboard hosts quests that walk users through on-chain actions such as staking, swapping and minting, rewarding them for completing each one. Projects use it to bring real users to their apps. Blockscout's Unichain app marketplace lists Superboard.
content.meta: Superboard is a Web3 quest platform that rewards users for trying apps, listed for Unichain.
